environment: Production Tincanban in agent browser; unchanged board history
diagnosis: Automerge.view materializes the entire document. Two whole-document views per ordinary entity transition dominated history admission. Scoped reads preserve historical heads and conflict winners while materializing only accessed entities and parents.

audit.resolution: Scoped entity reads for identified operations; full transition validation retained for ambiguous operations. Removed discarded Text diff expansion.
Version restoration reads the selected historical item instead of the whole historical document.
Full previews require whole views. Cache identical heads only within one preview refresh and owning document lifetime.
Ancestry checks read hash/dependency metadata without decoding operation payloads.
Genesis signing reads change hashes from metadata.
Rekey coverage reads change hashes from metadata.
Compaction reads included hashes from metadata.

Inspected full before/after hydration for visitor and automation restrictions. These perform complete forbidden-change comparisons; not replaced by unchecked partial comparisons. Rust policy cost remains separately measured.

version restoration preserves durable placement on failure then succeeds
large signed history with responsive controls and durable commit
